reason: This is a multi-file change in the core statistics auto-analyze pipeline, not a local bug fix. It changes how DML deltas are propagated into the new priority queue, touches queue/job scheduling, refresher flow, stats cache, and shared interfaces, and spans partitioned/non-partitioned table paths. That can materially affect statistics freshness and therefore optimizer cardinality/cost behavior across many queries, so it is central and risky enough for a Blocker/High-focused deep review.
